question_set_contract.dependency_contract: Question 1 directly retrieves Topic 1 vector-component knowledge. Question 7 mixes that prerequisite with current work calculation.
question_set_contract.difficulty_progression: component recall and exact definition, then direction and angle diagnostics, followed by direct and reverse calculations, signed multi-force work, and a two-stage angled-force synthesis

evidence_basis.originality_note: All contexts, wording, numerical values and diagram briefs are original. The set reproduces only controlled assessment demands, not official question stories or data.

questions.prompt: A force of 50 N acts at 37 degrees above the horizontal. What is the horizontal component of the force?
State what is meant by work done.
A student carries a tray 8.0 m horizontally at constant height. The student exerts an upward support force of 45 N on the tray. What is the work done by this support force?
A constant force of 75 N acts at 60 degrees to a displacement of 4.0 m. What is the work done by the force?
A loading system uses constant forces along straight paths.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: A motor exerts a force of 240 N along a conveyor while a package moves 6.5 m. Calculate the work done by the motor.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: A cleaning brush transfers 624 J by work against a constant resistive force while moving 5.2 m. Calculate the magnitude of the resistive force.

questions.prompt: A hand truck moves 14 m in a straight horizontal line. A worker exerts a constant 190 N force in the direction of motion. A constant 65 N resistive force acts opposite to the motion.

figure.purpose: Support sign reasoning by displaying the worker force, resistance and displacement directions.
figure.brief: Original black-and-white Cambridge-inspired line diagram. Show a hand truck with a 14 m rightward displacement arrow, a 190 N rightward worker-force arrow and a 65 N leftward resistance arrow. All data also appear in the prompt, so the question remains answerable while assets are deferred.
figure.alt_text: A hand truck moves right for 14 metres with a 190 newton driving force right and a 65 newton resistance left.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the work done by the worker's force.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the work done by the resistive force. Include the sign of your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Determine the total work done by these two forces on the hand truck.

questions.prompt: A rescue sled is pulled over level snow in two straight stages. In stage 1, a cable exerts a force of 170 N at 28 degrees above the horizontal while the sled moves 22 m horizontally. In stage 2, a horizontal force of 125 N moves the sled a further 16 m.

figure.purpose: Organise the angled first stage and horizontal second stage without revealing the required component or work values.
figure.brief: Original black-and-white Cambridge-inspired two-panel line diagram. Panel 1 shows a sled, 170 N cable at 28 degrees and 22 m horizontal displacement. Panel 2 shows 125 N horizontal force and 16 m displacement. Include no resolved components or calculations. All data also appear in the prompt.
figure.alt_text: A rescue sled is pulled first by an angled cable over 22 metres and then by a horizontal force over 16 metres.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the component of the cable force in the direction of the stage 1 displacement.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the work done by the cable during stage 1.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Calculate the work done by the horizontal force during stage 2.

parts.label: (d)
